rules: Use multi-stage build — build with maven/gradle, run with JRE-only image
Use eclipse-temurin:XX-jre-alpine for the runtime stage (not full JDK)
Copy only the final JAR/WAR into the runner stage
Use EXPOSE to document the listening port
securityRequirements: No credentials or .env files copied into the image
Use JRE image (not JDK) in the runner stage
USER instruction must appear before CMD/ENTRYPOINT
